prompt: Stage 4-2, augment taken, level 8 with 46 gold and 49 HP. Sivir is your carry: 1-star with Infinity Edge and Guinsoo's Rageblade, and a second copy on the bench. 4-costs have 10 copies each. Read the scout report, count the Sivirs out of the pool, and decide whether to roll now.

lobby.note: Sivir 1-star on the board, Hunter 3, no items on her
Hunter 4 around a 2-star Tristana, no Sivir
Sold their Sivir last round, now on Coven

options.label: Roll now to a floor of 10: seven Sivirs are in the pool, one contester holds one, and 46 gold at level 8 is a real rolldown
Pivot: two Hunter boards means Sivir is contested, so sell her and roll for Ahri
Hold 46 and roll at 4-5, once Seat 1 is out and Seat 3 has fallen further

explanation:
Count before you roll, and count copies, not boards. You hold 2 Sivirs. Seat 3 holds 1. Seat 6 plays Hunter but has no Sivir, and Seat 1 sold theirs, which put it back in the pool. That is 3 out of 10, so 7 remain, and one contester with a single naked copy is normal contest on a 4-cost line. With the 4-cost tier near 125 copies after the lobby's boards, a level-8 slot shows Sivir about 1.7% of the time and a shop about 8%. Eighteen shops, 36 gold, find at least one copy roughly 78% of the time, and one is all you need.

The pivot is the wrong read: 'two Hunter boards' is a trait count, not a Sivir count, and Ahri is 2-star with Blossom 5 on the strongest board in the lobby, real contest by a player far ahead of you. Waiting to 4-5 does not improve the pool; Seat 3 rolling with income does, in their favour, and Seat 6 buys any Sivir they see. Two rounds at 12 a loss also puts you at 25 HP, the two-losses line.

Seven in the pool, one soft contester, 46 gold at 8: this is what a rolldown is for.
principle: Contest is a count of copies out of the pool, not a count of boards on the trait.
commonMistake: Reading every board on the carry's trait as a contester and pivoting off a 4-cost with seven copies still in the pool.
hint: List each seat's Sivir copies, add your own, subtract from 10, then price a shop at level 8.
